summary: Full backend + frontend verification for Syntrix. Created pytest suite covering 14 engine algorithms, 10 scenario regressions, public /api/sample endpoints (simulate, optimize, pdf, csv), auth fail-closed, and role matrix (VIEWER/ANALYST/ADMIN) via FastAPI dependency overrides against real Mongo. 55/55 backend tests pass. Frontend desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) smoke across Dashboard, Network, Simulator, Impact, Recovery, Results, Comparison, Timeline, Reports: all data-testids present, no horizontal overflow at either viewport, run-simulation + generate-recovery + plan selection + exports all wired. /api/auth/status correctly reports Supabase unavailable (owner-supplied anon key still rejected). KPIs match engine (dashboard shows 92.2% vs engine 92.15% canonical).

minor.issue: Returns warnings on W1-W4 (lane capacity > dispatch capacity). Not a bug - simulation enforces node cap - but worth tightening seed capacities to remove noise in exported validation reports.

issues: Emergent dev-time code annotator injects <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> elements, producing React hydration warnings in console. This is an environment artifact (not in source code), but if left in production build it will emit warnings. Not functional.
Recharts emits width/height=-1 warnings when sparkline containers initially render before layout settles. Non-fatal, charts still render correctly after.

action_items: No functional fixes required. Optional: tighten W1-W4 lane capacity in seed.py to eliminate validate_network warnings. Optional: suppress the dev-time annotator (<span> inside <option>) before shipping to production.

External blocker (unchanged): owner must supply a working Supabase public anon key - /api/auth/status currently correctly reports unavailable, Login UI must continue to show the honest unavailable banner.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py and engine.py are tight, async-safe, and use env vars exclusively. No MongoDB ObjectId leaks (BaseDocument.to_mongo serializes with str id as _id).

auth.py correctly: (1) rejects missing bearer, (2) rejects non-200 Supabase responses, (3) falls back to VIEWER for unknown roles, (4) grants ADMIN only when email_confirmed_at is present AND email matches OWNER_EMAIL. Role-injection via headers is impossible - role is derived server-side from Supabase app_metadata only.
engine.supplier_mip enforces budget and 75% overtime cap deterministically; inventory_flow caps on reserve W5 inventory; reroute uses only existing alternate lanes - all verified by tests.

simulate() correctly initializes a steady-state pipeline and dispatches downstream-first using topological order (comment in code explicitly explains why - prevents artificial baseline shortage). Baseline 100% service verified across all 10 regression scenarios.
pytest.ini pins -n 2 --dist loadscope; tests respect that and share one preview backend.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke across 9 routes + run-simulate + generate-recovery + plan-select + export buttons present

test_credentials: No real Supabase accounts; role matrix tested via FastAPI dependency_overrides(current_user) with synthetic Principal objects (VIEWER/ANALYST/ADMIN). No live auth attempted (owner-supplied anon key returns 401 from Supabase, as documented).
seed_data_creation: Mongo scenarios collection: test suite creates TEST_-prefixed ScenarioDocument records via override; admin-delete test cleans up its own doc, analyst-created docs remain (owner_id='u-analyst'/'u-admin'/'u-other-analyst') and are harmless since they are scoped per owner_id.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_syntrix_backend.py (pytest -n 2). Covers engine, HTTP public endpoints via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, and role matrix via httpx AsyncClient + ASGITransport (motor requires rebinding to the test event loop - handled in a module-scoped fixture). All green. Frontend testids used: nav-{dashboard,network,simulator,impact,recovery,results,comparison,timeline,reports}, run-simulation, generate-recovery, expand-plan-{id}, select-plan-{id}, export-pdf, export-csv, scenario-name. Mobile 390x844 and Desktop 1920x1080 both show no horizontal overflow.
rca of the issue: No new issues found. Pre-existing documented blocker: Supabase anon key supplied by owner returns HTTP 401 Invalid API key from /auth/v1/settings and /auth/v1/user. Mitigation: /api/auth/status surfaces this honestly and Login UI shows unavailable banner; sample workspace continues to function with full synthetic KPIs. Resolution requires the owner to supply a valid public anon key - no code change needed.
